subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Do the responsible owners accept advancing the per-agent SQLite schema from v11 to v12 for ACP parent-stream diagnostics, including the proposed upgrade and cleanup behavior?
rationale: Repository policy reserves SQLite schema-version advances for explicit user discussion and acceptance; automated review cannot infer that approval from the refactor rationale or test coverage.

options.title: Accept the v12 migration
options.body: Approve the schema bump after confirming that session-owned ACP diagnostic rows and their upgrade behavior are the intended durable contract.

options.title: Keep the existing schema
options.body: Require an alternative that avoids a schema-version advance, such as retaining diagnostics outside persisted agent storage until a later approved migration.

options.title: Defer the storage portion
options.body: Land only separable non-schema cleanup later and pause the ACP persistence migration for dedicated owner review.

recommendation.title: Accept the v12 migration
recommendation.body: Approve the schema bump after confirming that session-owned ACP diagnostic rows and their upgrade behavior are the intended durable contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged related SQLite session/transcript migration makes this the strongest available adjacent storage-boundary routing candidate.
